subject: Post-discovery: 30-min product intro — 3 time windows for Spectral AI
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Bryan Lee <bryan.lee@spectralai.com>, Anita Gomez <anita.g@spectralai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-09T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery: 30-min product intro — 3 time windows for Spectral AI

Thanks again for taking the time today — good conversation. Quick recap and next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Discovery highlights: you’re evaluating inference cost reduction for batch scoring and a low-latency path for interactive tools. Primary blockers are compliance (audit logs) and predictable p50/p95 latency.
- Main stakeholders to include on the demo: CTO (you), ML lead (Anita), and someone from infra/SRE for network/peering constraints.

We’d like to do a 30-minute product intro + brief technical deep-dive. Please pick one of these windows (all times PDT):

Option A — Tue Aug 11, 9:00–9:30 AM PDT
Option B — Tue Aug 11, 11:30–12:00 PM PDT
Option C — Wed Aug 12, 2:00–2:30 PM PDT

Marcus (SE) will walk through an end-to-end inference flow and demo the KV cache + batching example aligned to your batch scoring use case. Monica (CS) will cover onboarding and SLAs. If you have a preferred slot, I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short pre-demo checklist (attendees + data access notes).

Attaching my quick discovery notes and a short list of pre-demo questions. If any of the times don’t work, send 1–2 alternate windows and we’ll match calendars.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: discovery-notes-20260809.pdf (summary), pre-demo-questions.txt (3 items)

From: Bryan Lee <bryan.lee@spectralai.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anita Gomez <anita.g@spectralai.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: 30-min product intro — 3 time windows for Spectral AI

Hi Stephanie — thanks for the recap and notes. Option B (Tue Aug 11, 11:30–12:00 PM PDT) works best for us. Anita and I can make that time; I’ll ask Raj (our SRE lead) to join if he’s available.

Two quick asks before the call:
1) Can Marcus include an example that shows latency distributions (p50/p95) for mixed short/long prompts?
2) We might want to see an example of a model fallback policy if a quantized variant misses quality thresholds.

Send the invite and any pre-demo items. Looking forward to it.

-Bryan
CTO, Spectral AI
bryan.lee@spectralai.com
